ambient_events: A drone hums overhead, chassis stenciled with a faded corporate logo.
The departure board flickers: COLDWATER → DENVER → [SIGNAL LOST].
description: A cracked concrete plaza ringed by dead streetlights still standing at attention. This is the northern gate into Coldwater proper — the LED departure boards here flicker through routes that no longer run anywhere.

flags.intro_lore: Dead streetlights stand at attention over a plaza that hasn't hosted anything but muggings in years. This is where a lot of fresh prints wander first, blinking in the light — which is exactly why the people who feed on fresh prints wait here. Keep moving. Standing still on the Threshold reads as an invitation.

name: Threshold Plaza North
